## TL;DR

Check progress on the board card, task drawer, and pipeline card now shares one component and honest labels: a thin bar only when step or test fractions exist, no decorative “step —” filler, no handoff attempt counts in the UI, and work actions hide while `handoffInFlight` or a live check holds the task. The robot assignment control sits in the card header beside priority.

## Work and rationale

Driver feedback on #1049 called out four problems: fake indeterminate bars, “step —” when Vitest had already reported `tests 3/680`, duplicate “running checks” lines, and meaningless `attempt 14` from cumulative handoff starts. Scope grew to drawer layout, pipeline parity, action gating, and robot placement.

`checkProgressDetailLabel` omits the step clause when only test numerators exist. `ChecksProgressDisplay.vue` is the single surface for card, drawer (three-line layout in global CSS), and pipeline variants. `activeTaskChecksBusy` gates card footer actions and drawer Start/Restart/Pause/Review so they track the same signal as the status line. Attempt numbers were removed from card and drawer; host stays on drawer footer line three; optional `auto-retry N of M` uses `check_retry_count`, not handoff attempt.

The task-card robot moved into the top header row left of the priority pill so a full-width checks block no longer wraps the control onto a second line.

## Approaches tried

A shared formatter plus one Vue component beat inlining template in three parents. Drawer title versus card `Checks ·` wording intentionally diverge: the panel’s first status row still matches the card for #1023, while the nested drawer box carries `Running checks · elapsed` and the half-width bar row. Suppressing `checksFailedAfterRetries` while live check signals are active fixed the badge contradiction without reordering the global priority list.

## Challenges and blockers

Many tests encoded the old multi-row drawer, `attempt N` suffixes, and `running checks ·` copy. Pipeline and shot fixtures needed extension (`drawer:checksProgress`, `pipeline:checksProgress`, `card:checksReuse`). Remote validation had an unrelated flake on a prior pass; the scoped suite was re-run after test updates. First handoff failed with `reused check inputs changed during handoff` because main advanced while the gate reused an earlier run; merged current `main` into the task branch and re-ran `repoos check` before re-handoff.

## Key learnings

Lifetime handoff attempt counters must not surface as user-facing “attempt” during a gate. When consolidating status UI, one component and one busy predicate prevent card, drawer, and pipeline drift. Hiding primary actions during checks is as important as simplifying the status copy — otherwise Restart invites concurrent handoffs.
